pages.text: TerraFirma Things registers insulation values for footwear and crowns with temperature mods. Effects apply automatically when the relevant mod is installed — no extra configuration required.

pages.title: Snow Shoes
pages.text: $(li)$(thing)TFC Ambiental:$() +0.6 warmth, −0.15 potency$(li)$(thing)Cold Sweat:$() +4.0 cold insulation$(li)$(thing)Thermia:$() +0.12 insulation modifier

pages.title: Hiking Boots
pages.text: $(li)$(thing)TFC Ambiental:$() +0.4 warmth, −0.15 potency$(li)$(thing)Cold Sweat:$() +2.0 cold insulation$(li)$(thing)Thermia:$() +0.08 insulation modifier

pages.title: Crowns
pages.text: $(li)$(thing)TFC Ambiental:$() −0.1 warmth, +0.05 potency$(li)$(thing)Cold Sweat:$() −2.0 cold insulation$(li)$(thing)Thermia:$() −0.2 insulation modifier
